_comment: ADOPT: the AI-system governance register for models whose outputs materially affect a consumer. Mounted as docs/governance/ai-governance.json and read by scripts/ai-governance-check.mjs. It joins the shipping model pin to accountable ownership, human oversight, bilingual disclosure, monitoring, incident response and stress-test evidence. It does not run the model, observe production, judge an explanation or prove that an intervention works. A green gate means the control design is complete, pinned and evidenced — never that the runtime honoured it.
_regulatory_basis: CBUAE Guidance Note on Consumer Protection and Responsible Adoption and Use of AI and ML by LFIs, issued 11 February 2026: sections 2 Governance and Accountability, 4 Transparency and Explainability, 5 Data Quality Privacy and Security, 6 Continuous Monitoring and Review, 7 Human Oversight and Consumer Protection, and 9 Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk. The institution's obligations register remains the source of record for its legal interpretation.

systems.role: ADOPT: model role, exactly matching docs/governance/model-manifest.json
systems.use_case: ADOPT: what the system decides or materially influences for a consumer
systems.accountable_owner: ADOPT: identity id of a human holding accountable-executive, outside builders

human_oversight.operator_role: ADOPT: role trained and authorised to review or intervene
human_oversight.intervention_path: ADOPT: how the operator pauses, rejects or overrides the AI outcome
human_oversight.alternative_arrangement: ADOPT: the non-AI route available when the customer requests it
human_oversight.customer_review_path: ADOPT: where the customer asks for human review
human_oversight.overrides_recorded_in: ADOPT: immutable or controlled record feeding model monitoring

disclosure.english_surface: ADOPT: exact screen, letter or script where AI use is disclosed in English
disclosure.arabic_surface: ADOPT: exact screen, letter or script where AI use is disclosed in Arabic

metrics: ADOPT: outcome quality, drift, override and consumer-harm indicators
monitoring.incident_runbook: ADOPT: path or controlled reference for the AI incident path

systems.privacy_security_assessment: ADOPT: DPIA, threat model or controlled assessment reference covering this AI use
systems.third_party_assessment: ADOPT: outsourcing assessment reference when the model provider is external; otherwise omit

stress_test.ref: ADOPT: path to adversarial, robustness and unsafe-output test report
stress_test.sha256: ADOPT: sha256 of that report; the gate re-hashes it
